"libretro / No-Intro
NDS release index: full serial, region and original CRC/SHA1. Metadata is linked locally using library identifiers. ROMs are not uploaded.

libretro genre / developer / publisher
Linked using the release record's CRC. Missing fields remain unclassified. A ROM header checksum is not a full-ROM CRC.

libretro-thumbnails
Only Named_Boxarts images for confirmed releases are downloaded. Images belong to their rights holders and are not bundled in the APK.

GameTDB / DS-Homebrew
Public Game Code cover methods were investigated. Recorded GameTDB TLS/HTTP restrictions are not bypassed.

ScreenScraper
Not enabled. It requires your own developer authorization and user credentials, subject to account quotas. No other project's keys are used.

TwilightBoxart
Public source documentation was consulted. Its GPL-3.0 implementation was not copied.

No analytics reporting. HTTPS requests obtain public indexes and requested images. Paths, saves, ROMs and play history are not sent. Metadata is stored in app-private storage."

View bundled text, sources and local matching
Browse your local NDS games on two screens: find a game below and read its cover and description above. An installed compatible emulator runs the game. No ROMs are included.

Choose your game folder. The app scans its subfolders, reads icons from ROMs and matches bundled Chinese and English names, genres and descriptions. Setup starts one library task; covers wait for an allowed network. You can pause it at any time.

Find games through All, Genres, Folders, Favorites, Recent or Search. Organize library checks metadata and missing covers. Needs attention lists unresolved items. Missing bundled text is not a network error; repeating the task cannot create new descriptions.

A / Start confirms or launches; B goes back, Y opens details, X toggles favorites, and L / R switches tabs. Left / right changes pages. Settings contains folders, content language and network preferences. Display and startup contains default Home controls. See About for the verified RG key behavior.

Choose the folder holding your .nds games, or a parent with game subfolders. For example: SD card → ROMs → NDS. Enter it and tap the system Use this folder button. Do not choose the root of a card or internal storage.

This folder is used to recognize existing saves. It is not a ROM folder and selecting it does not back up saves. Choose the folder DraStic actually uses. You can add it later; browsing games does not require it.
Cannot read this folder. Your previous folder is retained. Enter an actual subfolder and allow read access.
Setup will organize game information and fetch missing covers when the network allows. You can pause at any time.

Counts use unique games; groups may overlap. Only conflicts require a decision. Covers can be fetched automatically; text gaps await content updates.
